training_target_shape: (N,128,128), -1 unannotated/padding, 0 background, positive IDs are distinct puncta, IDs have no meaning across crops
test_target_shape: (2,5,727,546), one expert per axis1 entry, -1 padding; never supplied to model
feature_description: Channel0 is the grayscale fluorescence image normalized per source field using intensity percentiles1 and99.8, clipped0..1. Channel1 is validity/annotation coverage: for training it identifies manually annotated ROI pixels; for test it identifies original image extent, not object locations. Train only where channel1==1 and train_y>=0. Do not treat positive instance IDs as global class labels. Predict individual punctum instances, not a binary semantic mask. Test field1 original727x546; field2 original80x204 and remaining padding ignored. Use each image separately, never smooth across samples.
input_units: normalized fluorescence intensity; pixel coordinate geometry, nominalxy0.07059082892416223micrometers for both benchmark images
grouping: 27 original 2D training fields, nonoverlapping128pixel crops retaining source-field IDs; original whole Dataset1 and Dataset2 benchmark fields held out by release authors. Animal/culture specimen identity not fully resolvable from released metadata; no independent-animal claim.
baseline_name: archived SynAPSeg custom 2D StarDist v3.6.0.8 masks, rescored
baseline_reference_type: archived specialist prediction; no local weight inference or refitting
terms: Dataset CC BY4.0 verified in authoritative Zenodo API; toolkit and manuscript source BSD-3-Clause. Preserve Schamber etal2026 attribution. Raw recordings remain ignored cache.
evaluation_regime: T3 code synthesis plus external supervised image fitting; archived specialist is a separate optimized pipeline comparison
metric_details: Per image and each of5experts, one-to-one IoU matching at>=0.5 and objectF1; primary equal mean over2images and5raters. Canonicalize every predicted mask by splitting disconnected painted IDs with8connectivity and removing<4pixel components. Human masks follow author preprocessing: same relabel/removal before maximum projection of any annotationstack paired to2Dimage. No consensus oracle or rater selection. Primary differs from original centroid-consensus analysis.
limitations: Only2heldoutfields; raters and puncta are not independent specimens
Synaptic protein puncta are anatomical proxies, not proven functional synapses
Training fields may share original animals/culture preparations; specimen transfer cannot be established
Archived specialist used different crops, validation/tuning and historical model selection; not strict equal-budget comparison
